items.natalie: It's a beautiful theme park with a spectacular view of the reservoir; its lovely flowers and plants attract gorgeous butterflies that also adorn the place... I have to highlight the kindness, charisma, and warmth with which Mr. Oscar Martín Roa and his lovely family welcomed us, making for a cozy and very pleasant stay.
items.julio: A magical place full of flowers and nature, with a spectacular landscape at a lookout point to relax. Its owners, don Oscar and Olga, and their children are wonderful human beings who radiate a beautiful energy.
items.oscarv: Excellent experience, a wonderful place — the owners make the stay even more special. I definitely recommend it and hope to return very soon.
items.juanpablo: A truly beautiful, unforgettable experience with the family, and the best part is that it's pet friendly.
items.laura: The experience is renewing, reflective, and lets you find a wonderful space and hosts.
items.mariaangelica: We had the chance to enjoy Holy Week with the family in the Valle de Tenza... it was definitely the best thing that could have happened to us, having Mr. Oscar Martín Roa's company, guidance, and professionalism.
items.ed: An excellent place to have a unique experience connecting with nature and with the purpose of being human on this planet. Beautiful landscapes, family recreation activities.

about.intro: This is a space created for you. So you can reconnect with nature, so your family can live something different, so together we can take care of what has given us the most: the earth.
about.quienesP1: We are a Colombian family who decided to pay tribute to planet Earth by creating a living space to honor it, protect it, and share its beauty with everyone.
about.quienesP2: Our dream is to build a sacred refuge for the conservation of our territory's flora and fauna. A place where every visitor — children, young people, adults, and grandparents — can reconnect with nature, awaken awareness, and find the balance between caring for the planet and caring for themselves.
about.quotePost: teaches us that protecting it also means protecting our own existence."
about.closing: 🌎 Because caring for the planet can be exciting too.

plans.heading: Choose how you want to experience Earth Park
plans.subtitle: Choose the experience that inspires you most
plans.institutionalButton: Get a quote for my institution

tesoros-del-valle-de-tenza.title: Tesoros del Valle de Tenza (Treasures of the Tenza Valley)
tesoros-del-valle-de-tenza.description: A journey that goes beyond tourism… to live, learn, and connect with the essence of the countryside. This plan is designed for those seeking an authentic experience: immersing yourself in local traditions, sharing with the farming community, and discovering the true cultural and natural treasures held by the Valle de Tenza.
includes: Traditional workshops: hand-milling sugarcane, making cuajada chicharrones, and basket weaving
Visit to a farmhouse and sheepfold
Tour of 4 lookout points: Mano del Minero, Hollywood Boyacense, Don Isaías, El Cristo
Boat ride among mountains and waterfalls on the La Esmeralda Reservoir
Full board: 3 breakfasts, 3 lunches, 2 dinners, 2 snacks
Lodging: 2 nights in a shared room
Local ice cream, traditional lunch, tour through Sutatenza/Somondoco/Macanal

conoce-y-descansa-en-macanal.title: Conoce y descansa en Macanal (Get to Know and Relax in Macanal)
conoce-y-descansa-en-macanal.description: Enjoy an unforgettable getaway in the heart of the Valle de Tenza. Sail the calm waters of the La Esmeralda Reservoir, take in the sweeping views from Macanal's most iconic lookout points, and savor the region's authentic flavors.
includes: Visit to Mirador del Cielo and Mirador "Mano del Minero"
Lodging at Earth Park or partner accommodations (*subject to choice and availability)
Guided walk to a farmhouse plus a snack

hollywood-boyacense.title: Conoce el Hollywood Boyacense (Discover the Boyacá Hollywood)
hollywood-boyacense.description: Sail the calm waters of the La Esmeralda Reservoir, take in the sweeping views from Macanal's most iconic lookout points, and enjoy traditional cuisine made by local hands. All in a single day.

vive-earth-park.title: Vive Earth Park (Live Earth Park)
vive-earth-park.description: Enjoy exclusive access to Earth Park, with a unique sensory experience that will connect you with nature.

raices-y-tradicion.title: Raíces y Tradición del Valle de Tenza (Roots and Tradition of the Tenza Valley)
raices-y-tradicion.description: Live an authentic experience guided by the hands and knowledge of local people. You'll learn the tradition of basket weaving in a craft workshop, enjoy traditional ice cream and a homemade lunch, all while exploring Sutatenza, Somondoco, and/or Macanal.
includes: Tour through the towns of Sutatenza, Somondoco, and/or Macanal

deja-tu-huella.title: Deja tu huella (Leave Your Mark)
deja-tu-huella.description: Imagine enjoying artisanal coffee, surrounded by nature, while painting your own work of art. An activity for all ages where you can relax, create, and reconnect with yourself and your surroundings.
includes: An artisanal drink (coffee or herbal infusion from the park)
Use of brushes and necessary materials
Free time to display and photograph your creation

plan-institucional.title: Institutional Plan — Universities and Educational Centers
plan-institucional.description: Designed for universities, technical institutions, and educational centers seeking a formative experience outside the classroom. We have hosted groups from the Universidad Pedagógica Nacional (UPN), SENA, and other institutions, tailoring each visit to the group's academic goals — from environmental education to wellness and teamwork. Every institutional plan is quoted according to the number of students, duration, and learning objectives.

stationsPage.intro: This is our journey through Earth Park — 7 stops designed for you to live, feel, and discover something different at each one. We invite you to experience it all, step by step, letting every station surprise you.

mariposa.name: Habitación Mariposa
mariposa.concept: The flight of transformation. Lightness, color, and the wonder of watching life change shape before your eyes.
amenities: Configurable capacity: 1 to 2 double beds + 1 single bed
Towels included for the full number of guests in the room

ancestros.name: Habitación Los Ancestros
ancestros.concept: Deep roots, living memory. The warm weight of rural heritage in every corner.

colibri.name: Habitación Colibrí
colibri.concept: Pure energy in motion. Color, speed, and the joy of being alive.
colibri.designNote: Turquoise/magenta accents, organic shapes, plenty of natural light.

orquidea.name: Habitación Orquídea
orquidea.concept: Quiet elegance. The delicacy that blooms when given time and care.
orquidea.designNote: Soft lilac/white tones, warm and gentle lighting.

frailejon.name: Habitación Frailejón
frailejon.concept: The silent guardian of water. Patience, protection, and the certainty that what matters most grows slowly.
frailejon.designNote: Soft green-silver tones, velvety textures, diffused light.

gastronomy.heading: Flavors born from the land
gastronomy.subtitle: Local flavors that accompany every moment of the day at Earth Park

caldo.name: Caldo de Costilla Earth Park (Beef Rib Soup)
caldo.description: A beef rib soup with creole potato, green peas, and fresh cilantro, prepared from 6:00 a.m. to greet you with the day's first aroma. The only breakfast served this way, made to fuel you before you head out to explore.
caldo.side: Hot beverage (Colanta hot chocolate or herbal tea), golden griddle-cooked arepa, and seasonal fruit.

arepa.name: Arepa con Queso y Mantequilla (Arepa with Cheese and Butter)
arepa.description: Corn arepa slow-cooked on a griddle (budare), served hot with melting farmer's cheese and artisanal butter. A simple classic made unhurried.

huevos.name: Huevos al Gusto (Eggs Your Way)
huevos.description: Scrambled, fried, or pericos-style with tomato and onion — made to order, exactly the way you like them.

hamburguesa.name: Hamburguesa Earth Park (Earth Park Burger)
hamburguesa.description: Our signature burger: house-specialty grilled beef patty, egg, fresh lettuce, tomato, crispy bacon, melted cheese, and ham, all on toasted bread. Served with french fries or potato wedges. A complete experience to close out the day.

pechuga.name: Pechuga a la Plancha (Grilled Chicken Breast)
pechuga.description: Chicken breast marinated for 30 minutes in lemon, garlic, and spices, grilled to the perfect point. Served with french fries or potato wedges — light, juicy, and full of flavor.

cenaValle.name: Cena del Valle (Valley Dinner)
cenaValle.description: The chef's dish, different each season: caldero-braised meats, mazamorra chiquita, or the protein of the day, always with local ingredients. Ask about the available option at check-in — every visit can bring a different surprise.
